parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello, Thornvale Country Market, Charlie speaking.

Hi, I'm calling because I'd like to open a couple of stalls to sell some of our products at your market.

Okay, I'll have to get your details so I can fill out an application form. What's your name?

It's Julia Smith.

I'll just write that down. We also need a business name.

Sure, it's Sunrise Farm. You may not have heard of us. We recently changed our name from Sunrise Estate.

Is your property in the local area?

It's about 20 kilometres from here.

That's great. We like to focus on local producers.

Can I also get a contact phone number?

My number is 0407 551 827.

Got it. Is that your mobile number?

That's right. And Julia, can you also give me your address?

Okay, it's 789 Green Road, and that's in Maplewood.

So, shall we talk about your first stall? What are you planning to sell?

I've been to your market, and I know you've got a lot of vegetable stalls, but we want to sell flowers. We'll pick them every morning before we come to the market. We've been growing them for about a year. We grow fruit too, but it's just for ourselves at the moment.

Okay, I'm sure you'll get plenty of customers.

We hope so.

Are you planning to sell anything else at the stall?

Well, my husband is a talented carpenter in his spare time. I've convinced him to turn his hobby into a small business.

What does he make? The market attracts a lot of customers looking for unique handicrafts made by local artists and craftsmen.

He makes some lovely furniture. It's all made out of locally sourced wood.

I see. We have other craftsmen at our market selling things like glass products and ceramic goods, so you'll fit in.

Great. Do we get a choice as to where we will be located?

Certainly. Our market's very big. There's what's known as the town end, and the opposite end is known as the river end.

That sounds better. That's where we'd like to be. If we're spending all day there, we may as well have some lovely scenery to look at. Now, I want to ask you about the size of the stall we'll get. What size is your standard space?

Our standard sites are 3.6 metres at the front and a length of 5.4 metres.

We might need a bit more space than that.

In that case, you can book a larger site with a length of 7.5 metres.

We'll do that.

So what about your second stall?

Well, we own a small café in town and we'd like to try opening a stall at the market.

What would you like to sell? Coffee, I suppose.

Well, we specialize in tea, actually. It's all organic, too. We're pretty famous for that locally.

If you're serving anything to eat or drink, you'll need a food licence, obviously. That's a must at our market.

That's fine. We've got that.

Is there anything else you want to sell? Cakes, sandwiches?

Well, we've recently started making our own chocolate, so we'd like to bring a few different kinds along to see how they go.

Great. Where would you like this stall to be located?

Well, with this one, we really want to be close to the entrance. That way we'll get the highest number of potential customers walking past.

That's a very sought-after location, but I'm sure we can find you a spot. And do you have any special requirements at all?

We'll have some equipment that needs to be powered, so we'll need a site that has electricity. We'll set up our own chairs as well. Is that okay?

Sure. And now we just need to talk about the rest of the application.

analyses.content: 女士自我介绍时明确提到现在的商业名称是 Sunrise Farm。
We also need a business name. Sure, it's Sunrise Farm. You may not have heard of us. We recently changed our name from Sunrise Estate.
不要填 Estate，录音说 "changed our name from Sunrise Estate"，Estate 是旧名字。
Can I also get a contact phone number? My number is 0407 551 827. Got it. Is that your mobile number?
注意数字听写时的连读和节奏，确保不要漏掉中间的数字。
直接听写女士报出的移动电话号码 0407551827。

I've been to your market, and I know you've got a lot of vegetable stalls, but we want to sell flowers. We'll pick them every morning before we come to the market. ... We grow fruit too, but it's just for ourselves at the moment.
不要听到 vegetable stalls 就填 vegetable，那是别人的摊位；也不要填 fruit，那是留给自己吃的。
女士说虽然市场有很多蔬菜摊位，但她们想卖的是 flowers（花），而且每天早上现摘。
What does he make? ... He makes some lovely furniture. It's all made out of locally sourced wood.
题目问的是卖什么产品，不要填 carpenter（职业）或者 wood（原材料）。
女士介绍她丈夫是木匠，制作可爱的 furniture（家具）并在市场上售卖。

There's what's known as the town end, and the opposite end is known as the river end. That sounds better. That's where we'd like to be. If we're spending all day there, we may as well have some lovely scenery to look at.
不要填 town，那是作为对比选项出现的，不是女士最终的选择。
关于摊位位置，女士听说有“城镇端”和“河流端”后，为了看风景（scenery），选择了 river end。
女士觉得标准的5.4米不够用，于是经理提供了 7.5 米的大一点的摊位，她接受了。

Our standard sites are 3.6 metres at the front and a length of 5.4 metres. We might need a bit more space than that. In that case, you can book a larger site with a length of 7.5 metres. We'll do that.
不要填 5.4，这是标准尺寸，已经被女士嫌小而拒绝了。
What would you like to sell? Coffee, I suppose. Well, we specialize in tea, actually. It's all organic, too.
不要填 coffee，这是经理的猜测，被 "actually" 这个转折词否定了。
谈到第二个摊位，经理猜测是咖啡，但女士纠正说她们专门经营有机的 tea（茶）。
Is there anything else you want to sell? Cakes, sandwiches? Well, we've recently started making our own chocolate, so we'd like to bring a few different kinds along to see how they go.
不要填 cakes 或 sandwiches，这是经理询问的干扰项，女士并没有确认要卖。
除了茶，女士补充说她们最近开始制作并想售卖几种 chocolate（巧克力）。
Great. Where would you like this stall to be located? Well, with this one, we really want to be close to the entrance. That way we'll get the highest number of potential customers walking past.
这里没有明显的干扰项，只要听到 "close to"（靠近）后面紧跟的词即可。
为了获得最大的人流量，女士特别要求这第二个摊位要靠近 entrance（入口）。
And do you have any special requirements at all? We'll have some equipment that needs to be powered, so we'll need a site that has electricity. We'll set up our own chairs as well.
不要填 chairs，原文说 "We'll set up our own chairs"（我们会自己带椅子），并不需要市场提供。
因为设备需要动力（powered），女士提出特别需求，场地必须要有 electricity（电力）。
